preconditions.description: The number of houses N must be greater than 1 and less than or equal to 100,000.
The number of roads must be exactly N-1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= N and 1 <= b <= N and a != b for a, b in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road must connect two distinct houses within the valid range.

postconditions.description: The first line of output must contain the smallest total length of the shortest paths.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.split()[1:]) == N and all(int(v) != i for i, v in enumerate(stdout.split()[1:], start=1))
postconditions.description: The second line must contain N space-separated distinct integers representing the new house assignments, with no villager staying in the same house.
